'page' is the combination's canada.ca application page the form finder starts from (recorded copy, US$0); 'missing' lists files IRCC names that have no saved copy (shown as Not found · Upload PDF). 'lines' (C11.7 part B) are what a person then does on the combination's Forms and Documents tabs, where no saved finder answer sets them up: each library form added by hand (whose form, and its channel when not a PDF upload), and each document line, whose new document type waits as a library proposal for a second person (P-108, C3.6).
